1.web: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,
1.asv: And he showed me a river of water of life, bright as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

2.web: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
2.asv: in the midst of the street thereof. And on this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve manner of fruits, yielding its fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

3.web: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants serve him.
3.asv: And there shall be no curse any more: and the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be therein: and his servants shall serve him;

4.web: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
4.asv: and they shall see his face; and his name shall be on their foreheads.

5.web: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.
5.asv: And there shall be night no more; and they need no light of lamp, neither light of sun; for the Lord God shall give them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

6.web: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”
6.asv: And he said unto me, These words are faithful and true: and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent his angel to show unto his servants the things which must shortly come to pass.

7.web: “Behold, I come quickly. Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
7.asv: And behold, I come quickly. Blessed is he that keepeth the words of the prophecy of this book.

8.web: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.
8.asv: And I John am he that heard and saw these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel that showed me these things.

9.web: He said to me, “See you don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”
9.asv: And he saith unto me, See thou do it not: I am a fellow-servant with thee and with thy brethren the prophets, and with them that keep the words of this book: worship God.

10.web: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.
10.asv: And he saith unto me, Seal not up the words of the prophecy of this book; for the time is at hand.

11.web: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”
11.asv: He that is unrighteous, let him do unrighteousness still: and he that is filthy, let him be made filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him do righteousness still: and he that is holy, let him be made holy still.

12.web: “Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
12.asv: Behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to render to each man according as his work is.

13.web: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
13.asv: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.

14.web: Blessed are those who do his commandments,that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.
14.asv: Blessed are they that wash their robes, that they may have the right to come to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.

15.web: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
15.asv: Without are the dogs, and the sorcerers, and the fornicators, and the murderers, and the idolaters, and every one that loveth and maketh a lie.

16.web: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David; the Bright and Morning Star.”
16.asv: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things for the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright, the morning star.

17.web: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.
17.asv: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And he that heareth, let him say, Come. And he that is athirst, let him come: he that will, let him take the water of life freely.

18.web: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book, if anyone adds to them, may God add to him the plagues which are written in this book.
18.asv: I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto them, God shall add unto him the plagues which are written in this book:

19.web: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, may God take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.
19.asv: and if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

20.web: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I come quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.
20.asv: He who testifieth these things saith, Yea: I come quickly. Amen: come, Lord Jesus.

21.web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
21.asv: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with the saints. Amen.
